steps.waiting: Hold your Pass flat against the back of the phone.
steps.authenticating: Opening a secure channel with your Pass…
steps.signing: Your Pass is signing. This can take up to a minute; keep it still.

errors.readPass: Could not read the Pass. Try again.
errors.confirmIdentity: Could not confirm it is you.

nfc.noReader: This device has no NFC reader.
nfc.off: NFC is turned off. Enable it in settings.
nfc.notDetected: No Pass detected. Hold it flat against the middle of the phone’s back and try again.
nfc.notItem: This card is not an ITEM NFI.
nfc.failed: Could not authenticate or sign with this Pass. Check its pairing key and hold it still.

pass.wrongPass: This is not the Pass you scanned.
pass.notPaired: This Pass is not paired yet. Complete setup in the ITEM app first.
pass.pairingKeyRequired: Enter this Pass’s application pairing key, then tap it again.
pass.tunnelFailed: Secure tunnel authentication failed. Check the application pairing key.
pass.noDiagnostics: The tunnel opened, but the Pass did not return signing diagnostics.
pass.noKeyRing: This Pass has no signing KeyRing yet.
pass.exportFailed: The tunnel opened, but the Pass could not export its signing public key.
pass.keyChanged: This Pass’s signing key changed. Re-enrollment is required.
pass.digestSize: The Pass can only sign a 32-byte digest.
pass.signFailed: The tunnel opened, but the Pass could not sign the challenge.
pass.ringChanged: The Pass changed its active signing ring during confirmation.
pass.notVerified: The Pass signature could not be verified.
pass.keepStill: Keep the Pass against the NFC antenna and try again.
pass.credentialsInvalid: Saved Pass credentials are invalid. Reinstall or reset this app to enroll again.

biometrics.notSetUp: Set up Face ID or a fingerprint on this device to use your Pass.
biometrics.lockout: Biometrics are locked. Unlock your device and try again.

stellar.notEd25519: This Pass’s signing key is not Ed25519, so it cannot pay on Stellar.
stellar.hasTrustline: This Pass’s Stellar account already has a USDC trustline.
stellar.signatureMismatch: The Pass signature does not match this Stellar transaction.
stellar.signInFirst: Sign in with your Pass to see its Stellar account.
stellar.receiverMissing: Set EXPO_PUBLIC_STELLAR_RECEIVER to a Stellar G… address to send funds.
stellar.loadAccount: Could not load the Stellar account ({{status}}).

codes.op_underfunded: Not enough USDC on this Pass’s Stellar account.
codes.op_no_trust: This Pass’s Stellar account has no USDC trustline.
codes.op_src_no_trust: This Pass’s Stellar account has no USDC trustline. Add it from the dashboard.
codes.op_no_destination: The receiver account does not exist on Stellar.
codes.op_no_issuer: The USDC issuer does not exist on this network.
codes.op_line_full: The receiver cannot hold more USDC.
codes.op_not_authorized: The receiver is not authorized to hold USDC.
codes.op_low_reserve: Not enough XLM on this Pass’s Stellar account to add the USDC trustline.
codes.tx_bad_seq: Another transaction from this Pass landed first. Try again.
codes.tx_too_late: The signed payment expired. Try again.
codes.tx_insufficient_balance: Not enough XLM on this Pass’s Stellar account to pay the fee.
codes.tx_insufficient_fee: The network fee is too low right now. Try again.
codes.tx_bad_auth: The Pass signature was not accepted for this account.
codes.tx_no_source_account: This Pass has no Stellar account yet. Fund it with XLM first.

bunq.apiKeyMissing: Set EXPO_PUBLIC_BUNQ_API_KEY to connect to bunq.
bunq.keyPair: Could not generate the bunq key pair.
bunq.noInstallation: bunq did not return an installation token.
bunq.noSession: bunq did not open a session.
bunq.noAccount: This bunq user has no account a card can be linked to.
bunq.notCreated: bunq did not create the card.
bunq.limitNotApplied: bunq accepted the new limit but the card still shows {{actual}} EUR (expected {{expected}}).
bunq.cardName: Name the card in 1 to {{max}} characters.
bunq.maxCards: You can have up to {{max}} cards.
bunq.creationPending: bunq is taking too long to create the card. Wait a minute and pull to refresh the dashboard before trying again, so you don’t order two cards.
